newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas to sell Lobo Trend - NYTimes.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas to sell Lobo Trend - NYTimes.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp is close to a deal to sell its Lobo Trend natural gas field in southern Texas to DuPont Co's Conoco unit for about $1.2 billion, the New York Times reported Saturday.
The article, which quotes unnamed sources, said TransTexas hired investment bankers in August to help find buyers for the field, which the article says is one of TransTexas' prime properties.
Neither company would comment for the article. A spokesman for TransTexas reached by telephone Sunday said the company would not comment on the article.
Attempts to get comment from DuPont were unsuccessful.
The article said the deal was expected to be announced within the next few days.
